from datetime import datetime

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import create_app


def make(client, url, **kw):
    r = client.post("/bookmarks", json={"url": url, **kw})
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    return r.json()


def test_health(client):
    assert client.get("/health").json() == {"status": "ok"}


def test_create_defaults(client):
    b = make(client, "https://example.com")
    assert b["id"] == 1
    assert b["title"] == "https://example.com"
    assert b["tags"] == []
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(b["created_at"])
    assert dt.utcoffset().total_seconds() == 0


def test_create_normalises(client):
    b = make(client, "http://a.com/x", title="  Hi  ", tags=[" Py ", "py", "", "  ", "Abc"])
    assert b["title"] == "Hi"
    assert b["tags"] == ["abc", "py"]
    assert make(client, "http://b.com", title="   ")["title"] == "http://b.com"
    assert make(client, "http://c.com")["id"] == 3


@pytest.mark.parametrize("body", [
    {}, {"url": "ftp://x.com"}, {"url": "example.com"}, {"url": "http://"},
    {"url": "https://"}, {"url": ""}, {"url": None}, {"url": 5}, {"url": "http:///path"},
])
def test_create_invalid(client, body):
    assert client.post("/bookmarks", json=body).status_code == 422


def test_duplicate(client):
    make(client, "https://x.com")
    r = client.post("/bookmarks", json={"url": "https://x.com"})
    assert r.status_code == 409
    assert r.json() == {"detail": "duplicate url"}


def test_get_and_404(client):
    b = make(client, "https://x.com")
    assert client.get(f"/bookmarks/{b['id']}").json() == b
    r = client.get("/bookmarks/999")
    assert r.status_code == 404 and r.json() == {"detail": "not found"}


def test_list_order_and_filters(client):
    make(client, "https://python.org", title="Python", tags=["lang", "Py"])
    make(client, "https://rust-lang.org", title="Rust", tags=["lang"])
    make(client, "https://news.ycombinator.com", title="HN")
    r = client.get("/bookmarks")
    assert [b["id"] for b in r.json()] == [3, 2, 1]
    assert [b["id"] for b in client.get("/bookmarks", params={"tag": " LANG "}).json()] == [2, 1]
    assert [b["id"] for b in client.get("/bookmarks", params={"q": "PYTH"}).json()] == [1]
    assert [b["id"] for b in client.get("/bookmarks", params={"q": "ycomb"}).json()] == [3]
    assert [b["id"] for b in client.get("/bookmarks", params={"q": "rust", "tag": "py"}).json()] == []
    assert [b["id"] for b in client.get("/bookmarks", params={"limit": 1, "offset": 1}).json()] == [2]
    assert client.get("/bookmarks", params={"offset": 10}).json() == []


def test_q_literal_wildcards(client):
    make(client, "https://a.com", title="100% done")
    make(client, "https://b.com", title="1000 done")
    assert [b["id"] for b in client.get("/bookmarks", params={"q": "0%"}).json()] == [1]
    assert client.get("/bookmarks", params={"q": "_"}).json() == []


def test_default_limit(client):
    for i in range(25):
        make(client, f"https://e{i}.com")
    assert len(client.get("/bookmarks").json()) == 20
    assert len(client.get("/bookmarks", params={"limit": 100}).json()) == 25


@pytest.mark.parametrize("params", [{"limit": 0}, {"limit": 101}, {"offset": -1}, {"limit": "x"}])
def test_list_bad_params(client, params):
    assert client.get("/bookmarks", params=params).status_code == 422


def test_patch(client):
    b = make(client, "https://x.com", title="X", tags=["a", "b"])
    r = client.patch(f"/bookmarks/{b['id']}", json={"title": "  New "})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["title"] == "New" and r.json()["tags"] == ["a", "b"]
    r = client.patch(f"/bookmarks/{b['id']}", json={"tags": ["Z", "z", " c"]})
    assert r.json()["tags"] == ["c", "z"] and r.json()["title"] == "New"
    r = client.patch(f"/bookmarks/{b['id']}", json={"title": "  "})
    assert r.json()["title"] == "https://x.com"
    r = client.patch(f"/bookmarks/{b['id']}", json={})
    assert r.json() == client.get(f"/bookmarks/{b['id']}").json()
    assert r.json()["created_at"] == b["created_at"]


def test_patch_url_and_404(client):
    b = make(client, "https://x.com")
    assert client.patch(f"/bookmarks/{b['id']}", json={"url": "https://y.com"}).status_code == 422
    assert client.get(f"/bookmarks/{b['id']}").json()["url"] == "https://x.com"
    r = client.patch("/bookmarks/42", json={"title": "x"})
    assert r.status_code == 404 and r.json() == {"detail": "not found"}


def test_delete(client):

    make(client, "https://a.com", tags=["b", "a"])

    client.patch(f"/bookmarks/{c['id']}", json={"tags": []})
    assert client.get("/tags").json() == [{"name": "a", "count": 2}, {"name": "b", "count": 1}]

    with TestClient(create_app(p2)) as c:
        assert c.get("/bookmarks").json() == []
